title: Sprint Engine role manifest
description: A declarative Sprint Engine role (v2). Pure data: the runtime composes the agent prompt from the referenced skill ids. No code is executed, so third-party roles are safe to install (Tier 1). A role is routing + directive packs — `directives.implement` composes the owner's startup brief and `directives.<phase>` adds role-scoped content to that phase's shared base pack. Mirror of src/shared/sprintengine/role-manifest.ts and sprintengine_core/role_registry.py.

summary.description: One-line description of what the role does.

icon.description: Optional icon id for role lists.

aliases.description: Alternate ids that resolve to this role.

directives.description: Directive packs keyed by lifecycle step. `implement` is required; each post-implementation phase key adds role-scoped content to that phase's shared base pack.

directiveList.description: Ordered skill references composing this directive pack.
